function_before.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.handle_new_user()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
AS $function$
BEGIN
  INSERT INTO public.perfiles (id, email, nombre, rol, estado)
  VALUES (
    new.id, 
    new.email, 
    new.raw_user_meta_data->>'nombre',
    COALESCE(new.raw_user_meta_data->>'rol', 'Operativo'),
    'activo'
  );
  RETURN new;
END;
$function$

function_after.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.handle_new_user()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
begin
 -- A display name may come from metadata; authorization never does.
 -- New accounts receive no modules. An existing authorized administrator must
 -- assign any role/module through the established administration workflow.
 insert into public.perfiles(id,email,nombre,rol,estado,modulos_permitidos)
 values(new.id,new.email,new.raw_user_meta_data->>'nombre','Operativo','activo','{}'::text[])
 on conflict(id) do nothing;
 return new;
end $function$

trigger.definition: CREATE TRIGGER on_auth_user_created AFTER INSERT ON auth.users FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION handle_new_user()
